attributes.action: Make school swimming and water safety a protected core part of education
attributes.additional_details:
We believe every child should leave primary school able to swim and understand the dangers of rivers, lakes, canals and open water.

Swimming is a life-saving skill, yet many children leave school without meeting the expected standard.

We want the Government to fund swimming lessons, provide practical water safety education and offer catch-up lessons for children who cannot swim confidently.

Better swimming and water safety education could help prevent drownings and save lives.
attributes.background: Require every child to receive adequate swimming and water safety education

rejection.details:
Education on water safety is already in the school curriculum and we have this petition open (below) on strengthening provision of such education, which you may wish to sign:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770973
